Artemis and the Space Launch System
• NASA's Artemis program uses the Space
 Launch System to deliver the Orion crew
 vehicle to lunar orbit.

• SLS is the most powerful rocket NASA has
 ever built, which means greater loads on the
 launch structure like the mobile launch pad
 during lift-off.

LAVA Structured Cartesian CFD Solver

• LAVA Structured Cartesian solver ideal for inviscid flow design optimization where geometry may be rapidly
 changing between design iterations

• The LAVA solver was used extensively for the redesign efforts of the KSC launch pad for SLS starting in 2012.

Artemis Master title
 Launchpad style
 Simulations
• Previously we presented a suite of 13 lofted vehicle simulations at 6
 different liftoff times for two different trajectories, Artemis I and Artemis II
 Max Drift, run within the LAVA (Launch Ascent and Vehicle Aerodynamics)
 Framework
 o Artemis I is the trajectory followed by the vehicle launch on November 16, 2022
 o Artemis II Max Drift is a simulated “max drift” trajectory taken from a separate set
 of analyses where the vehicle was closest to the tower
• All 13 simulations were run “dry” meaning there was no simulation of the
 water systems on the launchpad.
• In this presentation we present a “wet” simulation where launchpad
 water systems are simulated for the Artemis I trajectory at 7 seconds.
 o We compare this simulation with its dry counterpart.

National Aeronautics and Space Administration NASA @ SC24
Click to edit
Artemis Master title
 multiphase style
 simulation methodology
• Five species formulation with Liquid Water, Water Vapor, SRB plumes,
 SSME plumes, and air
 o Phase transition effects between liquid water and water vapor
• Four RS-25s given the same steady, radially varying boundary conditions
 at the exit plane
• Two RSRMs given the same steady, radially varying boundary conditions
 at the exit plane
• Adiabatic wall boundary conditions for all geometry surfaces

• Simulations compute a duration of 4 physical seconds
 - Solution is stationary (in completed cases) after 2 seconds
 - Last second of completed cases are used for analysis for AR1 07 sec 10% plume mass fraction
 consistency across all cases
